database_architecture.description: Two categories: env-scoped application databases and one global ops database.

global.admin: Ops control plane — promotion logs, business artifacts, framework version. No env prefix.

admin_collections.framework_version: Single document {_id: 'framework', version: '1.1', name: '...', changelog: [...]}. Source of truth for architectural maturity level.
admin_collections.promotion_log: Audit trail of all environment promotions (who, when, from, to, build number)

rules: All application databases use {env}_ prefix — zero hardcoded names
admin is global, one instance, tracks cross-environment operations
ENV_PREFIX is set per deployment (dev, qa, prod) and routes all DB access

build_number.description: System-wide atomic counter. One number tracks all changes across all components.
rules: Every deploy of any component (website, pipeline, chat) increments by 1
Every environment has its own counter (dev_System, qa_System, prod_System)
Promotion DOES increment — every promotion (code or data) bumps the target environment's build counter
The number is the audit trail: what was tested is what shipped
A promotion (code or data) is a build — always bumps target environment counter

dev_to_qa.trigger: Manual — merge dev to qa branch
dev_to_qa.build_action: Set qa_System.build_counter to dev's current number (copy, not increment)
dev_to_qa.verification: QA tests against this build number
dev_to_qa.sign_off: GPT reviews QA report, Boss approves

qa_to_prod.trigger: Manual — merge qa to main branch
qa_to_prod.build_action: Set prod_System.build_counter to QA's signed-off number (copy, not increment)

version_number.description: Manual semantic version (e.g., v0.1.2). Set in APP_VERSION env var.
version_number.increment_rule: Boss decides when to bump version. Build number is automatic.

website.deploy_path: dev branch → GH Actions → Cloudflare Pages

chat_app.deploy_path: dev/qa branch → GH Actions → HuggingFace Space

pipeline.deploy_path: main branch → GH Actions → Azure Functions

ops_scripts.bump_build.py: Increment build counter for an environment
ops_scripts.promote_build.py: Copy build number from source env to target env (does NOT increment)
ops_scripts.promote_data.py: Copy provider data (PublicHealthData + SpecialtyMetaData) between environments on frontend cluster

known_bugs.description: Factual health questions misclassified as medical advice. Example: 'What is the most common form of breast cancer?' was declined as medical advice when it should be answered as general health knowledge.
known_bugs.root_cause: RULE 2 too aggressive — 'You know NOTHING else' blocks factual health knowledge that aids navigation.
known_bugs.fix: Prompt tuning: distinguish factual health questions from personal medical advice.
